# `aitbc coin-requests reconcile`

Check executed coin requests against the chain and report or annotate discrepancies.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc coin-requests reconcile [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--rpc-url` | text | — | no | Blockchain RPC to check against (defaults to BLOCKCHAIN_RPC_URL) |
| `--annotate` | flag | `false` | no | Record the discrepancy in each affected request's audit log |
| `--chain-id` | text | — | no | Island to query; omit to let the node answer for its own chain |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc coin-requests reconcile
RPC_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8202/rpc
aitbc coin-requests reconcile --rpc-url "$RPC_URL"
```
